dct_creator_sm: Philippe Archambault (Université Laval, Québec-Océan, Biology Department, Laval University).
dct_description_sm: The objective was to determine what drives spatial variation in benthic remineralisation function measured as benthic boundary fluxes in the Beaufort Sea/Mackenzie Shelf. We tackle our objective by addressing the following subjects: (1) ineffectiveness of oxygen flux as proxy for spatial patterns in benthic boundary fluxes; (2) timescales and distinct environmental forcings on different biogeochemical fluxes; and (3) statistical modelling of benthic remineralisation function using environmental parameters.
dct_title_s: Benthic ecosystem functioning in the Arctic
